characterList.description: Blonde woman, often wearing a light-colored trench coat or a floral dress. She is the leader of the Angels.
characterList.name: Elizabeth Banks (Bosley)

characterList.description: Short blonde hair, edgy style, often wearing a tank top or casual clothing. Skilled in combat and espionage.
characterList.name: Kristen Stewart (Sabina)

characterList.description: Woman with dark hair, often pulled back in a ponytail. She is a scientist and programmer.
characterList.name: Naomi Scott (Elena)

characterList.description: Tall woman with dark hair, often in athletic attire. She is physically strong and skilled with weapons.
characterList.name: Ella Balinska (Jane)

characterList.description: Black man with a grey beard, often wearing a dark-colored turtleneck and scarf. A handler for the Angels.
characterList.name: Djimon Hounsou (Edgar Bosley)

characterList.description: Older white man with a bald head, often wearing a light-colored suit. He is a retired Bosley.
characterList.name: Patrick Stewart (Older Bosley)

characterList.description: Man with a short beard and a shaved head, wearing glasses and often a white shirt. One of the antagonists.
characterList.name: Jonathan Tucker (Hodak)

content_metadata.description: Analysis of the trailer for the Charlie's Angels movie.

qAndA.answer: It is not explicitly stated in the trailer, but it is described as a product that can 'revolutionize the power industry' but also 'be weaponized.'
qAndA.question: What is the weapon the Angels are trying to retrieve?
What is the name of the agency the Angels work for?
What does the Asian man ask Kristen Stewart before she throws him off the balcony?

qAndA.answer: At least two: one for clothing and another for weapons and gadgets.
qAndA.question: How many closets are there in the Townsend Agency's headquarters?

qAndA.answer: "That felt nice." (said with a mischievous smile)
qAndA.question: What does Sabina say about how it felt to throw the man off the balcony?
